en.text:
Light attacks spawn 1 Wolfpack Round.

Grounded Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Pack Hunter' to you and allies in a ? meter radius for 10 seconds.

Pack Hunter buffs all Ergo Sum and Non-Exotic Swords. Pack Hunter causes sword swings to release 3 tracking submunitions that deal <pve 90 /> <pvp [33] /> damage each.

Wolfpack Rounds count as sword hits, and can benefit from both sword perks and Empowering buffs.
